name: minimax-agent-router
description: Delegate scoped Codex implementation chores to Claude Code CLI backed by MiniMax, including bounded parallel worker batches while Codex keeps planning, review, and final verification.

interface.shortDescription: Route safe coding chores to Claude Code + MiniMax, one task or a bounded parallel batch.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin that lets Codex supervise Claude Code CLI through MiniMax for low-risk coding, test, documentation, and mechanical refactor work. It supports single delegated runs and bounded run-many batches for independent tasks. Codex keeps ownership of planning, architecture, security, review, deployment, and final verification.
